description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'HolidayDao' for managing holiday entities within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It includes methods for CRUD operations, searching, and querying holiday data from the database.

classes.name: HolidayDao
classes.description: A DAO class responsible for interacting with the holiday data in the database, including CRUD operations and complex queries based on search filters.

methods.name: saveHoliday
methods.description: Adds or updates a Holiday entity in the database and returns the persisted holiday.

methods.name: getHolidayById
methods.description: Retrieves a Holiday entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingHolidayIds
methods.description: Fetches existing holiday IDs from a list of IDs.

methods.name: searchHolidays
methods.description: Searches for holidays based on filter parameters, returning a list of matching Holidays.

methods.name: getSearchHolidaysPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator for holiday search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getHolidayByDate
methods.description: Finds a recurring holiday matching a specific date.

methods.name: deleteHolidays
methods.description: Deletes holidays specified by their IDs.
